name: Bathers Way: Nobbys to Merewether
blurb: Newcastle's coastal walk, past a convict-cut pool to huge ocean baths.
weatherNote: Hilly and exposed, with little shade: go early on hot days and cool off in the ocean baths. Skip it in rain or big seas.
gettingThere: Central Coast & Newcastle Line to Newcastle Interchange (≈ 2 hr 30, hourly), then light rail to Newcastle Beach and a 20 min walk to Nobbys. Bus 21 and the train take you back from Merewether.
newcomerTip: Pack swimmers: Newcastle and Merewether ocean baths are free. On Fridays and weekends Opal caps your whole day at $9.65, so the return trip costs less than you'd think.

legs.title: Central Coast & Newcastle Line to Newcastle Interchange
legs.detail: Hourly on weekends. Check the platform at Central

legs.title: North past the Ocean Baths to Nobbys Beach

back.text: It's one way. From Merewether Ocean Baths, walk up to Watkins St (≈ 8 min) for bus 21 to Broadmeadow station (≈ 22 min), then the Central Coast & Newcastle Line to Central (≈ 2 hr 30). Allow about 3 hours.

notes: Parking in Newcastle varies by street: check the signs and pay by meter or the EasyPark app.
It's a one-way walk: park at one end and take a bus or rideshare back to your car.

routes.ride: Handy in Newcastle for the one-way walk: ride from Merewether back to your start. From Sydney it's too far.

extras.label: Lunch or a kiosk snack on the way

visit.bestTime: Catch an early train and start by late morning. Swim at Merewether at the end, but not on a Thursday, when it's closed all day for cleaning.
visit.hours: The walk is always open. Merewether Ocean Baths close all day on Thursdays and Newcastle Ocean Baths on Wednesdays for cleaning. Lifeguards are on at Merewether 9am to 5.30pm until 26 April 2027.
facilities: Change rooms at both ocean baths, open daily from 5.30am
Beach kiosks and cafés along the way
visit.access: The council is building a stair-free shared path for the whole 6 km, but the King Edward Park and Memorial Drive stages aren't built yet. The Bogey Hole doesn't cater for people with access needs.
safety: Swim only at patrolled beaches and baths when lifeguards are on
Our tip: at the Bogey Hole, waves wash over the walls at high tide and in big seas, so only swim when it's calm

pairings.name: Newcastle Museum
pairings.why: Free museum near the station, good if it rains

places.name: Nobbys Beach
places.note: Start by the breakwater to Nobbys Lighthouse, then head south.

places.name: Newcastle Ocean Baths
places.note: Free art deco saltwater baths from 1922. Closed Wednesdays for cleaning.

places.name: Bogey Hole
places.note: Ocean pool cut into the rock by convicts in 1819 for the commandant.

places.name: Strzelecki Lookout
places.note: Big coastal views, then the Memorial Walk along the clifftop.

places.name: Bar Beach
places.note: Surf beach, then on past Dixon Park to Merewether.

places.name: Merewether Ocean Baths
places.note: Finish with a swim. Closed Thursdays. Bus 21 leaves from Watkins St.

unconfirmed.note: We found no current closure for the Bogey Hole, but it has closed before for cliff repairs: check with Visit Newcastle before you plan a swim.
We couldn't confirm which parts of today's route have stairs: the council hasn't published an access map.
